units: Ex. R. s. 1.—בעל א׳ mighty, violent.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 7:7:2">Y. Peah. VII, 20ᶜ</cite> top; v. infra.—
<cite ref="Sotah 41b:7">Sot. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>אגרופָהּ של חנופה</he> the power of sycophancy.—Pl. <he>אֶגְרוֹפִים</he>, <he>אֶגְרוֹפִין</he>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 76b:17">Kidd. 76ᵇ</cite> <he>בעלי א׳ וכ׳</he> the men of power of the house of David; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 49a:9">Snh. 49ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 53b:6">Pes. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>בעל א׳</he> a strong, violent man (opp. <he>גברא רבה</he> a great man).
